rule: Telegraphed boss staging. Wake (sound and spot scan, then 181-tic hold), then a spit every 150 tics that launches a cube at the next spot in a round-robin ring. The cube's flight length is set at launch from distance over speed. On landing: fog, weighted minion spawn with see state if a player is found, telefrag, cube removed. Boss death: a per-type gate (alive player required, no other alive boss of the same type), then the tagged map event or exit. Death chain: 100-tic scream row of 65 puffs, two 10-tic holds, then exit. Splash immunity for two big bosses. Fan volleys are two-shot fans at 11.25 degrees.
keep: Telegraph: the cube's flight time is computed at launch from distance over speed, so the warning and the landing agree
Round-robin spit spots, so the lair's threat moves around the room
Cube landing as a delayed spawn at a visible spot, with fog before the spawn
Per-type boss-death gate that requires a living player and no other alive boss of the same type
Death chain order: event, staggered visual holds, then the exit
Two-shot fan volleys at a fixed angle for a readable wedge
change: Keep the easy-skill skip toggle in the engine per boss, not as a static global shared by all brains and levels
Guard the flight-time division by momentum (zero when the spot is on the same east-west line) and the modulo by spot count (zero spots)
Cap the spit spot list at build time and warn, instead of writing past a fixed array
Set the fan offset on each missile's own angle, since the spawn resets the missile angle to the aim
Cap alive cube spawns at three (MAX_ATTACKERS), since the donor has no cap
Telefrag becomes a push aside, so a spawn never kills a phone player
Exit is a server event with a grace timer, not a call from an animation frame
Our names and tables; spawns drawn from our Pit roster with per-zone weights
